import json
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import kendalltau, spearmanr
from demo import HERE, rank_series
components, ranking = rank_series(HERE / 'cdk2_ligands.csv', batch_size=4, weights='qcmlforge')
print('\nCurrent corrected qcmlforge AP2 ensemble:')
print(components.to_string(index=False, float_format='{:.2f}'.format))
print(ranking.to_string(index=False, float_format='{:.2f}'.format))
tau = float(kendalltau(ranking.E_total_ap2, ranking.dG_exp).statistic)
rho = float(spearmanr(ranking.E_total_ap2, ranking.dG_exp).statistic)
result = {'weights': 'qcmlforge', 'batch_size': 4, 'pocket_radius_angstrom': 12.0, 'n': len(ranking), 'tau': tau, 'rho': rho, 'components': components.to_dict(orient='records'), 'ranking': ranking.to_dict(orient='records')}
print('\nFULL_PRECISION_RESULT ' + json.dumps(result))
print(f'\nKendall tau = {tau:.2f}   Spearman rho = {rho:.2f}   (n = {len(ranking)})')
PY
